rememberLastStation.name: Remember last station
rememberLastStation.description: Stores the most recently selected station.

autoPlayLastStation.description: Starts the stored station when the addon loads.

playerCardPosition.name: Now-playing card at player name
playerCardPosition.description: Shows cover, title, and artist together as one card at your own player name.

playerCardScale.name: Now-playing card size
playerCardScale.description: Scales the complete card including its cover and text.

widgetEnabled.name: Widget enabled
widgetEnabled.description: Shows or hides the radio HUD in-game.

presenceEnabled.description: Shares station, title, artist, cover, and status with other addon users. Stream URLs and settings are never transmitted.

presencePrivacy.name: LabyConnect visibility
presencePrivacy.description: Controls who may see your Now Playing card and whose cards you receive.
